definitions.explanation: professional baseball in Japan, specifically Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB)

examples.japanese: プロ{野球|やきゅう}の{試合|しあい}を{見|み}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to see a professional baseball game.

examples.japanese: プロ{野球|やきゅう}{選手|せんしゅ}になるのが{夢|ゆめ}だ。
examples.english: My dream is to become a professional baseball player.

examples.japanese: プロ{野球|やきゅう}のシーズンが{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: The professional baseball season has started.

notes:
NPB STRUCTURE:
Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) consists of two leagues:
- セ・リーグ (Central League) - 6 teams
- パ・リーグ (Pacific League) - 6 teams

POPULAR TEAMS:
- {読売|よみうり}ジャイアンツ - Yomiuri Giants
- {阪神|はんしん}タイガース - Hanshin Tigers
- ソフトバンクホークス - SoftBank Hawks
- {広島|ひろしま}カープ - Hiroshima Carp

SEASON:
- {開幕|かいまく} - opening day
- ペナントレース - pennant race (regular season)
- クライマックスシリーズ - Climax Series (playoffs)
- {日本|にほん}シリーズ - Japan Series (championship)

RELATED:
- {高校|こうこう}{野球|やきゅう} - high school baseball
- メジャーリーグ - Major League Baseball
- {甲子園|こうしえん} - Koshien (famous high school baseball tournament)
